games.description: Sark starts the seven-rule urban legend, works an office day, breaks the bedroom-light rule, and gets trapped in a nightmare of colored switches and clock puzzles before using a skip and ending the first look.
games.title: 24H Stories: The Rule 7

games.description: A solo quest to build a toilet while trying not to wet himself. Sark hunts batteries and materials, recovers from height bugs and a crash, then enters the toilet dimension and crafts his way to the ending.
games.title: Don't Pee

games.description: Sark takes the E.R.D.’s six-module training program: entity identification, audio tests and field directives lead into a final exam with a personal surprise.
games.title: Lancaster Leak: Entity Exam

games.description: An interrogation gives way to bugs, Alastor’s shifting dimension and a bronze bull. Sark works through the tears puzzle and final password before reviewing the short horror story.
games.title: Martyrdom

games.description: Sark investigates a short home-invasion story in which a late-night noise sends the protagonist out of the bedroom and into danger.
games.title: Stories to Tell: Run Away

games.description: Sark monitors a house full of cameras, learns the translated reporting categories and struggles to identify anomalies before the mistakes pile up.
games.title: Surveillance Work
